grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a plain staple such as tinned chickpeas, eggs and Greek yoghurt.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any Tesco.

basic_kitchen.reason: A saucepan and a lidded frying pan are all it needs, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: About 1.8kg of veg goes into one frying pan with only 2 tbsp oil (500g potatoes, a cauliflower, 3 leeks, a tin of chickpeas and spinach), so it will steam rather than 'fry until crisp' in 12 minutes, and there is little room left to crack in four eggs.

honest_times.reason: Chopping plus about 17 minutes of hands-on frying fits roughly within 25 minutes of prep, and the boiling and egg-setting account for the 15 minutes of cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: The step says 'paprika' but the seasoning list has smoked paprika, and plain paprika is a separate cupboard item, so the reader may reach for the wrong jar.

seasonal_feel.reason: Late-April leeks lead a warm hash that suits a cool spring morning.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear and plainly worded in British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Vegetables, chickpeas, eggs and potatoes make a filling, balanced breakfast.
